title: Motor population co-smoothing
scientific_question: How well do 137 observed motor-cortex units predict the 45 unobserved units on 574 held-out development trials, beyond permitted movement-condition and time context?
primary_outputs: Observed withheld-unit integer spike counts on the fixed 140-bin 5 ms support; predictions are positive expected counts, not recovered true latent firing rates.

data_manifest.prepared_split_warning: Train/test NWBs and MC_Maze Large/Medium/Small variants are derived releases of a source acquisition, not independent datasets.

recording_contract.neural: Actual NWB header confirms units/spike_times with ragged spike_times_index, heldout-unit flags and observation intervals;182units in the inspected training file. Unit labels are not persistent identities across other sessions.
recording_contract.labels: Actual training NWB contains2295trial-table rows and columns active_target, barrier_pos, barrier_pos_index, delay, go_cue_time, id, maze_id, move_onset_time, num_barriers, num_targets, rt, split, start_time, stop_time, success, target_on_time, target_pos, target_pos_index, trial_type, trial_version. Hand position/velocity are timestamped behavioral arrays. Additional labels must be masked when they are prediction targets.
recording_contract.time_alignment: Sorted spike timestamps and trial/event times are aligned in the NWB time base. Official NWBDataset bins spikes on a1ms grid and resamples for5ms/20ms benchmarks; MC_Maze behavior uses timestamps, Area2 uses starting_time/rate. Rate values and unit conversion still need acquisition qualification.

biological_ids.session_description: Data from monkey Jenkins performing center-out delayed reaching task. This file contains trials from the full session on 2009-09-25 that can be used for training models for the Neural Latents Benchmark.

recording_contract.evidence: Direct published asset URL inspected with bounded HTTP ranges; HDF5 names/shapes and identity metadata only, not neural/behavior values.

missing_or_unverified: This specification does not establish a local public/private packet, payload equality or an executed task adapter.

primary.name: pooled_poisson_co_smoothing_bits_per_spike
primary.aggregation: Sum Poisson log-likelihood improvement over all fixed valid trial/bin/withheld-unit cells, divided by observed spikes and ln 2.
primary.rationale: Scores held-out measured spikes; evaluation-target per-unit mean is a private normalization, distinct from a deployable comparator.

secondary: Signed co-bps difference versus frozen training-only condition/time predictor.
Condition-wise and whole-trial error summaries; intact versus within-condition-shuffled and context-only inputs.

comparators.name: training_condition_time
comparators.inputs: Training withheld counts and permitted trial-condition/time context only.
comparators.procedure: Implemented fixed training profiles shrunk by one pseudo-trial toward smoothed global rate;60-bin Gaussian sigma 10; no query-neural input.

comparators.name: matched_input_controls
comparators.inputs: Same training source plus intact, within-condition-shuffled, context-only, training-rate-only or metadata-neutral query projection.
comparators.procedure: Implemented source projections; freeze shuffle and fit/adaptation per condition before scores. Actual complete matched execution remains unqualified.

nuisance_controls: Hold trial identity and conditions fixed when shuffling neural observations.
Whole trials stay together in selection; no target-dependent missingness.
Compare neural gain against condition/time structure, not only global rate.
evaluation.uncertainty: Report descriptive paired whole-trial/condition blocks within one session; no animal-population interval from 574 trials or 45 units.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all expected IDs/units/time bins and finite strictly positive expected_spikes_per_bin. Invalid/missing responses receive failure with no favorable subset. All-zero target spike total is explicitly undefined; negative scores remain valid.
